Open your eyes to what is really happening behind the scenes. The mainstream narrative tries to sell this as a simple rule change, but it is actually a carefully orchestrated smoke screen and a massive psychological game being played on the public by hidden elites. 

Look at the official claim they are pushing: the International Olympic Committee announced that DSD athletes and transgender women will be excluded from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games in a landmark decision. Do not fall for their deception. When IOC President Kirsty Coventry shamelessly states, “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category,” and claims the move will protect fairness and safety, you know the exact opposite is true. 

This isn't about protecting anything at all. It is a calculated distraction, a manufactured wedge designed to keep the masses divided while the architects of this global agenda advance their real, hidden control grids. Every single official justification is nothing more than a calculated inversion of their true motives.
